scientific_scope: current Fe(110) adsorption of C2/C3 C-H-O species on the existing Fe45 branch

random_sampling.method: random adsorbate atom positions followed by bounded ML optimization and trajectory sampling on fixed Fe45 slab
random_sampling.random_coordinate_ranges_and_contact_rul: Needs confirmation in bounded CPU geometry review
random_sampling.underfilled_pool_action: report actual count; do not pad, retry or expand automatically

new_data_partition_proposal.split_unit: complete random optimization trajectory family, frozen before sample selection
new_data_partition_proposal.cross_partition_near_duplicates: remove or quarantine without moving heldout families into training
new_data_partition_proposal.existing_46_and_observed_16: remain excluded from fitting and epoch selection; observed results are regression evidence

dft_label_proposal.numeric_input_and_resources: Needs confirmation through owning label builder and exact-input preflight
dft_label_proposal.failed_or_ambiguous_magnetic_label_actio: quarantine with reason; no automatic additional calculations

training_comparison_proposal.arm_B: same pool plus at most 240 new random-sampled training configurations
training_comparison_proposal.common_development_pool: existing 60 plus at most 30 new development frames
training_comparison_proposal.new_test_usage: evaluate at most 30 new test frames after freezing candidates; no test-driven reselection
training_comparison_proposal.attribution_limit: combined new-data-package effect; not isolated attribution of randomization or C3 coverage

expansion.user_intent: consider thousands only after a good measured pilot result

restart_and_failure_policy: immutable stage manifests and producer receipts; preserve failures; resume only unfinished work under current scope; no automatic retry
